items.title: Rocket Launches SEO Engine and GEO/AEO Engine for Automated Optimization
items.summary: Rocket has introduced new SEO and GEO/AEO Engines that automatically optimize websites for both traditional Google search and AI platforms like ChatGPT and Perplexity. The tools handle meta tags, structured data, sitemaps, audits, and content structuring for AI citations without needing specialists. This marks a significant advancement in notable SEO tools adapting to AI search changes.

items.title: Lily Ray Warns GEO Tactics Are Destroying SEO and AI Search Visibility
items.summary: SEO expert Lily Ray published a Substack article cautioning against misleading GEO case studies and risky tactics that harm core SEO performance. Glenn Gabe amplified the post, showing examples where AI visibility surged then dropped alongside organic rankings. This highlights the interconnected evolution of SEO, GEO, and AEO.

items.title: The Shift from Traditional SEO to GEO: AI Search Ends the Click Era
items.summary: A detailed thread explains how AI Overviews and tools like ChatGPT reduce website clicks despite higher impressions, dubbing it the 'Great Decoupling'. It advocates for GEO with structured content, E-E-A-T, proprietary data, and 'Search Everywhere Optimization' across platforms. Includes a 2026 SEO checklist focusing on AI citations over keywords.

items.title: Marketo Deprecates Built-in SEO Feature in Latest Release
items.summary: Adobe's Marketo Engage February 2026 release notes announce the sunsetting of its native SEO tool. The update shifts focus to new AI-powered content generation features in Email Designer. This reflects evolving priorities in content marketing tools amid AI advancements.

items.title: New GEO Data Reveals Decline in Top-10 Organic Citations in AI Overviews
items.summary: Latest analysis shows only 38% of AI Overview citations now come from top-10 organic results, down sharply from 76% in 2025. This data underscores the urgent need for content strategies to adapt to GEO and direct AI extraction. Implications for SEO in the AI search era are profound.

items.title: DesignRush Publishes March 2026 Ranking of Top SEO Agencies
items.summary: DesignRush has released its latest ranking of leading SEO agencies for March 2026, emphasizing technical SEO, content optimization, and structured data strategies. The list helps brands select partners amid Google updates and AI search shifts. Published just two days ago, it's timely for current trends.

items.title: Indie Darling to AI Debacle: Shy Girl’s Hachette Deal Collapses Over AI Allegations
items.summary: Horror novel Shy Girl transitioned from indie success to controversy when picked up by Hachette for US release. Viral BookTube and Reddit analyses flagged AI-generated patterns in the prose, prompting author denials of direct use. Hachette canceled the release amid industry backlash on AI in publishing.

items.title: Grammarly Discontinues AI 'Expert Review' Feature After Impersonating Authors
items.summary: Writing tool Grammarly ends its AI feature that mimicked prominent authors' styles for edit suggestions without permission. The move follows public backlash and a class-action lawsuit by journalist Julia Angwin. Highlights ethical issues in AI-assisted editing.

items.title: Vauban Books Promotes Conservative Piece on Saint-Denis Amid Traditional Publishing Push
items.summary: Publisher of Jean Raspail's The Camp of the Saints shares article by Hélène de Lauzun on cultural changes in Saint-Denis. Recommends public transport visit for Americans to observe past, present, and future colliding. Aligns with focus on traditional narratives.

items.title: Hachette Cancels 'Shy Girl' Release Following AI Writing Accusations
items.summary: Big Five publisher Hachette pulls horror novel Shy Girl after online communities questioned AI involvement in its creation. The book had gained indie traction before the deal. Incident sparks debate on detecting and preventing AI slop in traditional publishing.

items.title: Grammarly Removes Controversial AI Feature Mimicking Writers Amid Lawsuit
items.summary: Grammarly disables its AI Expert Review tool that imitated styles of writers and academics without consent. Faces multimillion-dollar lawsuit from affected parties. Reflects rising scrutiny on AI tools in writing and editing processes.

items.title: Agent Secures Major Deal for Three Innovative Zombie Novels
items.summary: Associate agent Renee Runge announces her first book deal representing three novels that redefine zombie media. Praises client's fresh take on the genre. Signals growing interest in unique storytelling in YA/MG publishing.
items.source: Renee Runge (via X announcement referenced in publishing circles)

items.title: Oscars Face Backlash for Diversity and Inclusion Requirements
items.summary: Critics expressed dissatisfaction with the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences' representation and inclusion standards for Oscar eligibility. The requirements, aimed at promoting diversity, drew complaints from those viewing them as forced ideological mandates. This reflects ongoing tensions over DEI policies in awards ceremonies.

items.title: Woke Films Keep Flopping and Hollywood Is Listening
items.summary: Warner Bros' 'The Bride!' suffered a major box office disappointment due to its overt feminist messaging and woke elements. The film joins a string of similar underperformers, prompting discussions on Hollywood's shift away from pandering content. Industry observers note audiences rejecting preachy narratives.

items.title: Oscars Exec Addresses Backlash Over Cutting KPop Demon Hunters Speech
items.summary: The Oscars production team cut short acceptance speeches, including that of KPop Demon Hunters, leading to public outcry. An executive admitted the challenge of interrupting winners' big moments during the live broadcast. The incident fueled debates on balancing time constraints with artistic recognition.

items.title: Rob Schmitt Unpacks Cringe Woke Nonsense at Oscars
items.summary: Newsmax host Rob Schmitt highlighted what he called idiotic and woke elements during the Oscars broadcast. He criticized the ceremony's preachy tone and content that alienated viewers. The commentary captures sentiment against politicized entertainment events.

items.title: Woke Virtue Signaling Doesn't Translate to Box Office Success
items.summary: Film critic Possum Reviews explains how woke hype generates social media buzz but fails to drive ticket sales. Recent examples include 'The Bride' and '1348 Ex Voto,' following patterns from 'Ghostbusters' reboot and others. Pandering to this demographic proves risky for studios.

items.title: Oscars Ratings Plunge to Lowest in Years After Preachy Ceremony
items.summary: The 98th Oscars attracted only 17.86 million viewers, the lowest in four years, blamed on a politicized show heavy on Trump jabs. Hosted by Conan O'Brien, the event's woke focus contributed to the decline. This underscores audience rejection of lecture-style entertainment.

items.title: This New AI Tool Runs 90% of My One-Person Business
items.summary: An entrepreneur reveals how a new AI tool automates 90% of their solo business operations, replacing five tools and saving over 20 hours weekly without needing code or staff. The tool handles core functions effectively, demonstrating real-world viability for solopreneurs. This highlights AI's transformative impact on small-scale operations.

items.title: Google Provides Free AI Marketing Team for Small Businesses in 170+ Countries
items.summary: Google has rolled out a free AI tool that scans a small business's website to generate customized ads, social posts, headlines, CTAs, and animated video creatives. Unlike generic templates, it produces brand-matched content accessible worldwide. This platform move empowers SMBs with professional marketing at no cost.

items.title: 10 Ways Small Businesses Are Using AI That Big Corporations Haven't Mastered
items.summary: Small businesses lead in practical AI adoption for tasks like 24/7 phone handling with tools like Rosie, cash flow forecasting, bias-free hiring, and agentic operations. They achieve 91% revenue boosts and hire more staff, outpacing bureaucratic large firms. Key insight: SMBs fix one workflow first for 3-4x ROI.
